title: ArcEngine Master Project, Variant and RuntimeContext
description: Profile != Variant. A PROFILE (manifest/render-profiles.json) is a category of presentation with capabilities and budgets. A VARIANT is one concrete presentation of ONE game: it references a profile and adds project-specific overrides. Variants are configuration, never copies: every variant of a project shares the same Game Model, world, entity ids, gameplay and asset registry, and conversion CREATES a variant instead of replacing one.

project.description: project.json — the Master Project descriptor (GENERATED by tools/variants.mjs from js/GameSpec.js + presentation/variants/*.json; never hand-edited)

gameModel.description: the single shared source of gameplay: js/GameSpec.js

assetRegistry.description: the single shared registry: GAME_SPEC.assets + presentation/mappings/*.json

variant.description: presentation/variants/<id>.json — hand/agent/editor authored, the canon for one variant

enabled.description: disabled variants are skipped by run --all and validate --all

createdFrom.description: the source variant a conversion/clone started from

camera.description: variant overrides of the profile's camera defaults

follow.description: entity id, or null for a static camera

distance.description: world px behind the followed entity (thirdPerson/orbit)

preset.description: a manifest lightingProfiles id (flat, stylized, isometric, lowpoly, realistic) or presentation/presets/<name>.json

shadows.description: the shadow MAP (view.sun.castShadows): 0 — no caster pass. It does NOT touch shadowStrength, the toon shadow tint, which a stylized game keeps while casting no map (blob shadows, mobile)

toon.description: toon banding: 1 — banded stylized light, 0 — smooth/PBR

ink.description: ink edges between faces: 0 — none, 1 — main objects, 2 — environment too

outline.description: outer silhouette outline (inverted hull / post effect): 0 — none, 1 — main objects, 2 — environment too

overrides.description: raw World3D.cfg() keys (sunIntensity, toonBands…): the last word, used sparingly

visualMappings.description: presentation/mappings/<name>.json (or an inline role -> profile -> variant map): which asset dresses which role in this variant

environment.description: world presentation overrides: { ground: 'tilemap'|'plane'|'terrain', sky: '#rrggbb', fog: n, tilePx: n, flatten: 0|1 }

ui.description: { space: 'screen'|'world', scale: n, hidden: [ids] } — the UI DEFINITION stays shared

performance.description: budget overrides; may only TIGHTEN the profile budget (validation fails on a looser one)

scenes.description: per-scene presentation presets inside this variant: { MainMenu: { camera: {...} } }

state.description: variant-local runtime/editor state (camera position, selection). Never gameplay: .variant-state/ is the on-disk equivalent

instance.description: tab/instance id: several variants of one project run side by side

contractHash.description: the game DEFINITION (rules, systems, the authored world, entity identities, scenes, roles, input, cue ids, the save schema): identical in every variant and every tab of a project — the proof that the variants share one game

gameplayHash.description: the LIVE model state (positions, logic, progression): a migration's preservation proof inside one session. Two playing tabs of one project legitimately differ

saveSchemaHash.description: identical in every variant — a save loads anywhere

conversion.description: Game.variant.convert({ source, target | profile }) — NON-DESTRUCTIVE: the source variant stays, the target variant is created (or updated) from the same Game Model

profile.description: target profile (required when target does not exist yet)

preserveSource.description: false is a destructive replace and must be requested explicitly
